in_arabic.name: سورھ
in_arabic.meaning: اسم من الأسماء القرآنية، ومعناه المبارك
in_arabic.long_meaning: الاسم سورة، ومعناه المبارك، وهو اسم من أسماء القرآن الكريم، يذكرها القرآن في سورة يس، ويشير إلى البارك، والفضائل والجود، ويستخدم في الإشارة إلى النبي محمد، ويشير إلى الفضل والجود، وهو اسم مشتق من الجذر س-ر-ح، والذي يعني البارك والجود، ويحتوي على تأثيرات إيجابية في الشخصية، ويعتبر من الأسماء الفاضلة في الإسلام

in_urdu.name: سورھ
in_urdu.meaning: قرآنی نام، جس کا مطلب مبارک ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: سورہ نام ہے، جس کا مطلب مبارک ہے، یہ قرآن کریم کے ایک نام ہے، جو قرآن میں سورہ اس کا ذکر ہوا ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے مبارک یا فضل، یہ نبی محمد صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ وسلم کا نام ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے فضل یا جود، یہ نام قرآن کے جذر س-ر-ح سے مشتق ہے، اور یہ بارک اور جود کا مطلب ہے، اور یہ نام مسلمانوں کے لئے فاضل ہے

in_hindi.name: सूरह
in_hindi.meaning: इस्लामिक नाम, जिसका अर्थ है कृपालु
in_hindi.long_meaning: सूरह नाम है, जिसका अर्थ है कृपालु या शुद्ध, यह एक महत्वपूर्ण नाम है जो कुरान में उल्लिखित है, जिसका अर्थ है फضل या जुद, यह नाम कुरान के जذر स-र-ह से मिलकर बना है, जिसका अर्थ है कृपालु और जुद, यह नाम मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है, और इसका उपयोग व्यक्ति के पुण्य और अच्छे कर्मों को दर्शाने के लिए किया जाता है

in_english.name: Surrah
in_english.meaning: An Islamic name meaning blessed, fortunate, or virtuous
in_english.long_meaning: The name Surrah is derived from the Arabic root S-R-H, meaning blessed, fortunate, or virtuous. It is a name that is mentioned in the Quran, specifically in Surah Yasin, and is associated with the qualities of being blessed, fortunate, or virtuous. In Islamic tradition, the name Surrah is considered to be a name of great significance and is often given to children born with certain characteristics or traits that are considered to be blessed or virtuous. The name Surrah is also associated with the concept of barakah, or blessings, and is believed to bring good fortune and prosperity to those who bear it. In terms of personality traits, individuals with the name Surrah are often considered to be kind, generous, and compassionate, with a strong sense of justice and a desire to do good deeds. Overall, the name Surrah is a beautiful and meaningful name that is deeply rooted in Islamic tradition and is associated with many positive qualities and characteristics.

data.cultural_impact: The term "Surrah" in Arabic means 'a beautiful garden.' This beautiful meaning has implications in Islamic culture due to its profound connection with nature and tranquility, which is a fundamental aspect of Islamic teachings. This name is often given to lovely and charming babies, evoking the idea of natural beauty, growth, and a valuable life.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, the name "Surrah" expresses a deep connection to the beauty and nourishment that comes from Allah Almighty. The Islamic perspective considers this world as a temporary garden from which we draw sustenance, and the next world as the eternal garden, where we experience true happiness and eternal bliss. The name Surrah thus serves as a reminder that our existence is a precious gift from Allah, and beautiful is the ['surrah' or grace] in it. (Quran, 90:8)
